description: End-to-end test scenarios for humans and AI browser automation agents. Covers auth, user management, role management with maker-checker workflow, hierarchy management, profile, permissions, and edge cases.

super_admin.notes: Seeded via `python manage.py seed_all`. is_superuser=True, has_global_access=True, must_change_password=False.

setup: Fresh DB: python manage.py migrate (on server/local).
Run: python manage.py seed_all — creates System Admin role + superadmin@ttwf.com user.
Start Celery worker (Windows): celery -A teach_the_world_dashboard worker -l info --pool=solo (note: settings auto-set pool=solo on win32).
Confirm EMAIL_HOST/HOST_USER/HOST_PASSWORD set in settings so notification + password emails actually dispatch.

test_role_basic.name: TestRole-{{timestamp}}
test_role_basic.description: Automated test role for maker-checker verification

scenarios.title: First-time login with seeded Super Admin
expected: Browser redirects to / (Dashboard)
Header shows 'Super Admin' name
Sidebar shows all module links (Dashboard, Roles, Hierarchy, Users, etc.)
No 'must change password' redirect (super admin has must_change_password=False)

scenarios.title: Login with wrong password — credentials preserved
expected: Error message shown: 'Incorrect credentials entered. Please try again.' (capitalized)
Email field STILL contains superadmin@ttwf.com
Password field is CLEARED (retype required)
User remains on /login page

scenarios.title: Login with non-existent email
expected: Error: 'Incorrect credentials entered...' (same message as wrong password, no email enumeration)
No information leak about whether email exists

scenarios.title: Login with soft-deleted user
preconditions: A user exists in DB with user_profile.deleted_at != null

steps.action: Attempt login with that user's credentials

expected: Login rejected with same generic error; no session created

scenarios.title: Login with inactive user (status=inactive)
preconditions: A user profile with status='inactive' exists
expected: Login rejected; no access granted

scenarios.title: Password visibility toggle (eye icon)

steps.action: Click the eye icon inside password field

expected: Password characters become visible (input type switches to text)
Clicking again toggles back to masked

scenarios.title: Force password change for freshly-created user
preconditions: A new user created via CreateUser with must_change_password=True (default)

steps.action: Login as that new user using the password received by email

expected: After login, user is redirected to /change_password
Sidebar is visible but clicking any other link redirects back to /change_password
Direct URL navigation (e.g., typing /users in address bar) also redirects to /change_password

scenarios.title: Successful force password change
expected: Notification: 'Password changed successfully!'
User redirected to first accessible page (Dashboard if permitted, else next accessible, else /my_profile)
User remains logged in (NOT logged out)
Can navigate freely now (no more forced redirect)
Verify by logging out and logging in with new password — must succeed

scenarios.title: Change password — wrong current password
expected: Error shown: 'Current password is incorrect.'
User remains on /change_password

scenarios.title: Change password — passwords don't match
expected: Error on confirm field: 'Passwords do not match.'
Page auto-scrolls to the first error field (confirm-password)

scenarios.title: Change password — new password too short
expected: Error: 'Password must be at least 8 characters.'

scenarios.title: Page refresh — stays on current page (no login flash)
expected: Page reloads directly on /users (no flash of /login)
Data loads normally
Header shows user info correctly

scenarios.title: Logout clears session and persistence

steps.action: While logged in, click the logout icon in header

expected: Redirected to /login
localStorage cleared (no access/refresh token, no user)
Direct access to protected routes redirects to /login

scenarios.title: Forgot password email flow
expected: Success message shown (no email enumeration)
Backend queues Celery email task
Email received with reset link → clicking opens /reset_password?token=...

scenarios.title: Create User — full happy path
preconditions: Logged in as user with users.can_add permission

steps.action: Fill all required: Employee ID, First Name, Last Name, Mobile (unique), Email (unique), Password, Confirm Password, Role, Designation, Gender
Select at least one country in Regional Access

expected: Success notification shown
Redirects to /users
New row appears in listing at top (sorted by -updated_at)
New user receives welcome email with credentials (Celery worker running)
New user's must_change_password=True (will be forced on first login)

scenarios.title: Create User — without access entity (validation)

steps.action: Fill all required fields but DON'T select any country and don't toggle Grant Global Access

expected: Error: 'At least one access permission is required.'
Save blocked; page auto-scrolls to access section

scenarios.title: Create User — duplicate email

steps.action: Try creating a user with email already in system

expected: Backend returns username error (username=email internally)
Frontend maps error to email field: 'A user with this username already exists.' (capitalized)
Page auto-scrolls to email field

scenarios.title: Create User — duplicate mobile number

steps.action: Use a mobile number already assigned to another user

expected: Error: 'Mobile number with this already exists.' or similar (unique constraint); save blocked

scenarios.title: Profile picture size enforcement (>1MB)

steps.action: Upload a 2MB image for profile picture

expected: Frontend pre-upload check: 'Image must be less than 1MB' shown, file cleared
If bypassed, backend rejects with same 1MB error

scenarios.title: Profile picture — invalid type (.pdf)

steps.action: Try uploading a PDF as profile picture via the file input

expected: File picker shows only image types (accept='image/*')
If file forced via browser: backend rejects with allowed-types error

scenarios.title: Create User — passwords mismatch + auto-scroll

steps.action: Scroll all the way down to password section (after hierarchy access)
Scroll to top and click Save

expected: Validation fails
Page auto-scrolls to first error field (employee_id or earlier), not stuck at top

scenarios.title: Edit User — update profile picture reflects in header immediately
preconditions: Logged in as any user with profile edit capability

steps.action: Click user avatar in header → navigates to /my_profile

expected: Header avatar updates immediately (no refresh needed)
Redux auth state updated; localStorage refreshed
On page refresh, avatar still shows the new image

scenarios.title: My Profile — Access Level section (read-only)

steps.action: Login as a non-global user with selective access

expected: Shows 5 cards: Countries, Provinces, Districts, Areas, Clusters
Each card has a count badge + list of accessible names
All cards read-only (no editing possible)
If user has_global_access=True → shows 'Global Access' banner instead

scenarios.title: My Profile — limited edit (basic info only)
expected: Editable: First Name, Last Name, Mobile Number, Profile Picture
Read-only/disabled: Employee ID, Email, Role, Designation, Gender, Status
Save updates only the editable fields

scenarios.title: Users listing — search works on name, email, designation, role, status

steps.action: On /users, enter each of these in search: a name, part of an email, a designation, a role name, 'active'/'inactive'

expected: Each search returns relevant users
Search is debounced (~500ms) — fires one request per stop of typing

scenarios.title: Users listing — hierarchy filter cascading

steps.action: Click Country dropdown → select a country
Click Province — should only show provinces for selected country
Continue through Region / Area / Cluster / School

expected: Each child dropdown only shows options under the selected parent
List of users filtered accordingly (users whose access M2M includes selected entity)
Dropdowns respect user access (filter_access=true) — users only see hierarchy they themselves can access

scenarios.title: Users listing — status tick/cross icons
expected: Active users show green check_circle icon
Inactive users show red cancel icon
No 'Active'/'Inactive' text — icons only for space

scenarios.title: Users listing — avatar or initials
expected: User with profile_picture → shows image in Full Name column
User without → shows initials (first letter of first+last name)
Image path resolves correctly (absolute URL or prepended with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL)

scenarios.title: Users listing — default sort is -updated_at
expected: Edited/created user appears at top of listing

scenarios.title: Users listing — no_page capped at 200

steps.action: Hit GET /api/v1/users/?no_page directly via browser URL or curl

expected: Response has at most 200 users, not all

scenarios.title: Right Sharing — debounced search

steps.action: On CreateUser/EditUser, scroll to 'Select User For Right Sharing'

expected: No API call fires until user stops typing (~300ms debounce)
Dropdown shows matching users; selecting one copies their access into form

scenarios.title: Grant Global Access — auto-selects all hierarchies incl. regions

steps.action: On CreateUser, toggle 'Grant Global Access' ON

expected: All Countries selected
All Provinces selected
All Districts selected
All Regions selected (regression fix — previously was empty)
All Areas selected
All Clusters selected
All Schools selected (if any exist)

scenarios.title: Edit User with existing access — cascading load

steps.action: Edit an existing user who has access to e.g. 2 countries, 3 provinces, 5 districts

expected: Page loads in ONE API call (/users/{id}/access-tree/), NOT 60+ cascading requests
All previously selected entities pre-checked
Unselecting a country cascades unselect for its descendants

scenarios.title: Delete user — soft delete + auth_user deactivated

steps.action: From listing, click delete icon on a user row, confirm

expected: Row disappears from listing
user_profile.deleted_at set
user.is_active=False in DB
That user can no longer login

scenarios.title: CascadingAccessColumn handles undefined data gracefully

steps.action: On fresh CreateUser page, before data loads, observe access columns

expected: No 'Cannot read properties of undefined' crash
Empty state shown with 'Select parent first' or similar

scenarios.title: Role create — ends in pending, email sent to checkers
preconditions: Logged in as user with roles.can_add
At least one role_checker user exists

steps.action: Enter name (unique), description, toggle some module permissions

expected: Notification: 'Role submitted for approval!'
Redirect to /roles
New role appears in listing with status badge 'Pending'
role_requests table has a new row (action=create, status=pending, created_by=current user)
Role.module_permissions is EMPTY (only applied on approval)
Celery task notify_checkers_role_created fires, email received by checkers

scenarios.title: Role create — checker sees it in Approval Queue

steps.action: Logout maker, login as a checker (different user with role_checker permission)

expected: Pending role visible in queue with badge count (e.g. '1')
Created By column shows maker's username
Review button visible in Actions

scenarios.title: Role approve — permissions applied, status becomes approved

steps.action: As checker, click Review on a pending role
Observe role details and proposed permissions

expected: Confirmation shown; redirect to /roles
Role now shows status 'Approved' in listing
Role.module_permissions populated with the proposed permissions (bulk_create)
role_requests row updated: status=approved, approved_by=checker, remarks stored
Role.approved_by = checker, Role.approval_status='approved'

scenarios.title: Role reject — role status becomes rejected, reason required

steps.action: As checker, click Review on a pending role
Click Reject WITHOUT remarks → should fail validation

expected: Step 2: error 'Rejection reason is required.'
Step 3: role status becomes 'Rejected'
Rejection reason visible in listing (tooltip/italic below status badge)
role_requests.status=rejected, remarks stored

scenarios.title: Self-approval blocked (maker ≠ approver)

steps.action: Login as a user who has BOTH can_add AND role_checker

expected: The user's own role is NOT shown in queue (excluded by created_by != current)
If attempted via direct API POST /roles/{id}/approve/: 403 'You cannot approve a request you created.'
Banner shown on Approval Queue: 'You cannot approve/reject roles created by you...'

scenarios.title: Update approved role — goes pending, old permissions remain active

steps.action: Edit an existing APPROVED role, change permissions
Check the role in DB / listing

expected: Role.approval_status=pending
Role.module_permissions UNCHANGED (still old/approved values)
New role_requests row created (action=update, payload contains new values, status=pending)
Users assigned to this role continue operating with OLD permissions until approval

scenarios.title: Update blocked while pending request exists

steps.action: Create/edit a role so it has a pending request
Try to edit and save again before approval

expected: Backend returns 400 with: 'This role has a pending approval request. Please wait for it to be reviewed.'
Frontend shows the message as general error

scenarios.title: Edit page pre-fills from latest pending payload

steps.action: Create a new role (status pending, permissions empty)

expected: Form shows name/description/permissions from latest_request.payload
Not an empty form (which would happen if reading from Role.module_permissions only)

scenarios.title: Checker with maker rights cannot approve role they edited
preconditions: User has both roles.can_add and role_checker permissions

steps.action: Another maker (User A) creates a role
User B (checker+maker) approves it → role becomes approved
User B edits the role (now goes pending again)
User B navigates to Approval Queue

expected: User B does NOT see their own pending request in queue
Direct API approve → 403 'You cannot approve a request you created.'
A different checker must approve

scenarios.title: Reject CREATE request → role becomes Rejected (unusable)

steps.action: Checker rejects a brand-new pending create role

expected: Role.approval_status=rejected, approved_by=null
Role.module_permissions stays empty
Role visible in listing with rejected badge + reason
Maker can edit and resubmit (creates a new UPDATE request)

scenarios.title: Reject UPDATE request → role reverts to approved (previous state valid)

steps.action: Edit an approved role → pending update

expected: Role.approval_status goes back to 'approved' (not rejected)
Role.module_permissions unchanged (still the previously approved state)
role_requests row has status=rejected with remarks

scenarios.title: Role Checker ↔ View auto-linking in permission grid

steps.action: Click Role Checker 'can_view' toggle to ON

expected: Step 2: Roles 'can_view' auto-turns ON
Step 4: Role Checker 'can_view' auto-turns OFF (dependent)

scenarios.title: Role Maker special permission is inactive (not shown)
expected: On CreateRole / EditRole, the 'Role Maker' special permission is NOT in the grid
Only Role Checker is in the special permissions section

scenarios.title: Roles listing — Excel export includes role name

steps.action: Open a role detail / permission grid

expected: File downloaded with sheet name = role name
First row contains role name as title, second row has headers
All modules listed with View/Add/Edit/Delete Yes/No/— (— for view-only/special)

scenarios.title: Delete role assigned to user → blocked

steps.action: Assign a role to at least one user

expected: Error: 'This role is assigned to users and cannot be deleted.'

scenarios.title: Duplicate role name (case-insensitive) rejected

steps.action: Try creating a role named 'SYSTEM ADMIN' (case differs)

scenarios.title: Tab visibility based on permissions

scenarios.expected_tabs: No tabs. Listing shows approved roles only. No Create/Edit/Delete.
No tabs (single listing). All roles with status badges. Create + Edit + Delete.
Two tabs: 'Roles' (approved only) and 'Approval Queue'. No Create.
Two tabs. Queue excludes own requests. Warning banner in queue.

Each entity created successfully, appears in listing

scenarios.title: Create region with All checkbox

steps.action: On CreateHeirarchy, scroll to Add Region

expected: All items in each column auto-checked
Region saved with members from all levels via RegionMember rows
Region shows in Regions tab

scenarios.title: Edit region with All checkbox

steps.action: Navigate to /edit_heirarchy, pick a region, toggle All on Countries column

expected: Same All functionality works on edit page

scenarios.title: Hierarchy dropdowns filtered by user access

scenarios.title: Delete hierarchy entity with children blocked

steps.action: Try deleting a country that has provinces

expected: Error: cannot delete while child entities exist; soft delete blocked

scenarios.title: Sidebar shows only modules user has can_view for

steps.action: Login as user whose role only has can_view on Dashboard + Users

expected: Sidebar shows only Dashboard + Users

scenarios.title: Direct URL access to unauthorized module redirects
expected: Redirected to first accessible route (Dashboard if has permission, else next, else /my_profile)
No flash of the restricted page

scenarios.title: Create/Edit buttons hidden when user lacks permission
preconditions: User with users.can_view only (no can_add, no can_edit, no can_delete)
expected: Create User button NOT visible
Edit + Delete icons NOT shown in row actions

scenarios.title: Backend enforces permissions even if frontend bypassed

steps.action: Login as user with users.can_view only
Directly curl POST /api/v1/users/ with token + payload

expected: Backend returns 403 Forbidden (ModulePerm class)
User NOT created

scenarios.title: Hierarchy Create/Edit buttons hidden without permission
expected: Create Location button hidden
Edit Location button hidden
Only read-only listing visible

scenarios.title: Table header text visible during and after sort

steps.action: Click a sortable column header multiple times

expected: Header text (name, email, etc.) stays visible at all times
No white-on-white invisibility after sort
Sort indicator arrow (▲ or ▼) displays correctly

scenarios.title: No empty white column after sort

steps.action: Sort a table by different columns

expected: Column widths remain consistent; no extra empty white column appears

scenarios.title: Loader appears in center during route transition
expected: Loading spinner shows in center of screen (h-screen container) during suspense fallback

scenarios.title: Header shows correct date + user info
expected: Today's date shown (format: Monday, April 13, 2026 etc.)
User name shown
Avatar image or initials
Clickable — opens /my_profile

scenarios.title: Sticky action bar on create/edit pages

steps.action: Open CreateUser, scroll down in the form

expected: Cancel + Save User Profile buttons stick at top while scrolling the form

scenarios.title: Create 200+ users rapidly — unique user_code

expected: Input limited to 500 chars in UI; backend also rejects if bypassed

scenarios.title: Special characters in role name (Unicode)

scenarios.title: Concurrent approval race — only one checker wins

steps.action: Two checkers open review page for same role
Both click approve at exactly the same time

expected: Only first request wins
Second receives 400: 'This request has already been reviewed.'

scenarios.title: Session token expired mid-action

steps.action: Login, wait until JWT access token expires

expected: Axios interceptor handles 401; refreshes token transparently using refresh token
Or, if refresh also invalid, logs out user and redirects to /login

scenarios.title: Profile update with no changes

steps.action: On MyProfile, click Update without changing anything

expected: Succeeds silently; no-op; no validation errors

scenarios.title: Region listed without any district assignment

steps.action: Create a region with only province-level members, no district

expected: Region shows in listing; doesn't break user access-tree endpoint

scenarios.title: User with no permissions — can see only profile
preconditions: Create a role with zero permissions, assign to a user
expected: Sidebar empty

Can still view/edit own profile and change password

scenarios.title: Role deletion after role is assigned then unassigned

steps.action: Assign role to user, then reassign another role to that user, leaving the first role with 0 assignments

expected: Deletes successfully (no users assigned)

scenarios.title: Stale frontend permissions after role update

steps.action: User A logged in with role R having can_view on Users
Admin edits role R to remove can_view on Users (approved)
User A continues browsing without logout

expected: User A's client still has stale permissions until refresh/logout
But backend rejects any API call to /users/ with 403
On next login, permissions refreshed in token response

scenarios.title: Celery worker down — emails queued but not sent
expected: Role creation succeeds immediately (doesn't block on worker)
Task queued in broker
Later when worker starts: all queued tasks execute (emails eventually sent)

scenarios.title: Create user with global access and no per-level access

steps.action: Toggle Grant Global Access; ensure no per-item selections

expected: Validation passes (global access satisfies 'at least one access' rule)
Backend creates no M2M rows but has_global_access=True

scenarios.title: View role listing while no roles exist (empty state)

steps.action: On fresh DB with no roles, open /roles

expected: Empty message shown: 'No roles found.' (not a crash)

scenarios.title: Large image (just under 1MB)

steps.action: Upload a 0.95MB JPG as profile picture

expected: Accepted; saved; shown in header + listing

scenarios.title: Approval Queue tab badge count accuracy

steps.action: Create 3 roles, all pending, none by current checker
Login as checker, view queue badge

expected: Badge shows '3'
Approve one → badge decreases to '2'

global_assertions: All list pages paginate by default (page_size=20 or 25).
All backend errors are capitalized on frontend display.
Auto-scroll to first validation error fires on create/edit forms.
All sticky action bars remain visible during scroll.
Session tokens persist across refresh (no login flash).
Permission visibility on frontend matches backend enforcement (no UI-only hiding).
test_run_checklist: P0 scenarios MUST all pass before release
P1 scenarios should pass; any failures are release-blocking bugs
Run seeded fresh DB before each P0 pass
Verify Celery worker running during any test with email side effects
